episodes.title: Former SSPX Spills the Beans on Trad Women Abuse
episodes.description:
Former SSPX Spills the Beans on Trad Women Abuse. 
Cassandra Hackstock knows all too well the facts surrounding the abuse of Trad Women. She will share her story and what she saw while a member of the cult like SSPX. 

#sspx #tradabuse #spiritualabuse #catholic #tradspousalabuse #cult #wherepeteris

Cassandra Hackstock's Article on Where Peter Is: https://wherepeteris.com/seven-years-in-the-sspx/
